note: Every entry must name a real owner. Prefer adding a route to the vendored backend over allowlisting. Entries ending in /* cover a whole subtree. knownGap:true means a genuine missing backend route that is documented and tracked as follow-up work, not a false positive.

entries.reason: FOUND BY THIS GATE on 2026-11-11: ui/src/components/settings/Settings.tsx calls GET /api/update/info in the non-desktop branch, but the vendored backend only registers /api/update/restart. The settings 'check for updates' call therefore 404s. This is the same class of drift as the session-execution-mode incident. Tracked as a separate functional PR; allowlisted only so the governance branch itself can pass CI.
